notes: Low-poly hand-painted frog in leather armour. Hands are closed fists (no finger bones) - a carrot gun will need a grip pose or fist-attach. Rest pose rebuilt from the bind pose (T-ish pose, slight crouch); the file's node pose was a hunched frame. No ears/tail. Auto-Rig Pro naming (.x = centre, .l/.r = sides). Facing +Z (glTF/Godot), +Y up, metres; soles at y=0, centred between the feet. Top of skull at y=0.850 (ears/hats excluded), crown point (x 0.012, y 0.850, z 0.129); head width 0.196 m, depth 0.183 m; head bone origin at (x -0.031, y 0.747, z 0.054). Rest pose T (upper arm 8 deg below horizontal). 22 bones, 1980 triangles. Bone local axes follow Blender's convention (+Y along each bone towards its child).
